name: faststats-mcp
description: Design, validate and publish FastStats charts and dashboards with Claude.
long_description: Lets Claude read your FastStats projects and build charts and dashboards for them. Claude writes charts in a compact spec; the extension checks every field against your project's metrics and dry-runs each chart with FastStats' preview endpoint before saving, so nothing broken is ever published. Deleting anything always needs your explicit confirmation, and a read-only mode hides every tool that writes.

api_key.title: FastStats API key
api_key.description: Create one on faststats.dev under Settings → API keys. Stored in your system keychain and only sent to FastStats.

default_project.title: Default project (optional)
default_project.description: Slug or id of the project to use when you don't name one, e.g. my-plugin. Leave empty to always pick a project.

read_only.title: Read-only mode
read_only.description: Hide every tool that creates, updates or deletes anything.
